Name: Steamdew Valley
Author: BardsongCay
Description:
[size=4][b]Steamdew Valley - Steampunk Reskin
[/b][/size]This mod transforms the entire world of Stardew Valley into a Victorian-inspired steampunk universe, complete with gears, brass, pipes, steam, and industrial charm.
[b]What’s Reskinned:[/b][list][*][b]Farm Buildings:[/b] Barn, Big Barn, Deluxe Barn, Coop, Big Coop, Deluxe Coop, Shed, Big Shed, Stable, Silo, Mill, Greenhouse, Fish Pond, Slime Hutch, Junimo Hut, Gold Clock
[*][b]Town Buildings:[/b] Pierre’s General Store, Clinic, Saloon, Blacksmith, Museum, Community Center (now Pelican Steamworks), and other town structures
[*][b]Other Structures:[/b] Mailbox, Well, all Obelisks (Desert, Water, Earth, Island), Beach Cabin
[*][b]UI & Menus:[/b] Title screen logo & buttons, character load/save screen, menu tiles, text boxes
[*][b]Maps:[/b] All four seasonal town overview maps (Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter)
[/list]Every texture has been carefully redesigned with steampunk aesthetics while keeping the original shapes and gameplay intact.
Includes animated chimney and pipe smoke on multiple buildings (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url]).Perfect for players who want to experience Stardew Valley through a fully immersive steampunk lens.
Enjoy your new mechanical valley!

AI Usage - Help with Coding and Concept art. Some of the gears, windows, and doors. None of the animations. I would say its AI Assisted, not AI Generated.

Downloads.Description: This mod transforms Stardew Valley into a steampunk world filled with gears, brass, and steam-powered machinery. It reskins nearly all buildings — including farm structures, town buildings (Pierre’s, Clinic, Saloon, Blacksmith, Community Center, etc.)
